milestone.title: Theme system polish — sync schema, live-apply picker, Alucard, Frappe-dim fix

intent.outcome: raul's Settings lane gets a Theme picker listing the 6 named palettes (latte / frappe / macchiato / mocha / dracula / alucard) plus a Default reset row, with swatches and a status preview row. Highlighting live-applies the palette; s saves it through mp config set ui.theme. Alucard (Dracula light) ships, Frappe's dim matches the other Catppuccin palettes, and one theme-name list feeds both mp and raul.

problem.description: Theme names are defined three times and have drifted: crates/mp/src/config.rs:346 and crates/mp/src/config_docs.rs:347 each declare UI_THEMES = [mocha, macchiato, frappe, latte, dracula] (validated at config_cmd.rs:571, advertised by `mp config schema`, which raul's Settings lane consumes), while crates/raul/src/theme.rs::ALL holds the actual palettes (plus MONOCHROME, used only for no-color mode at app.rs:890). Nothing checks mp's list against raul's palettes. The ui.theme description says 'Picked up at startup; relaunch to apply' — there is no live preview; ui.theme renders as a plain [choice] row. FRAPPE.dim is 0x949cbb (Overlay2) while LATTE / MACCHIATO / MOCHA use Subtext0, so Frappe should be 0xa5adce. Dracula's official light variant Alucard is missing. (raul's schema.rs `allowed: [mocha, latte]` is only a unit-test fixture, not the runtime list.) User directions from the audit: live-apply on highlight, persist on Save, include a Reset row, no custom user palettes.

in_scope: Single source: add `pub const UI_THEMES: &[&str] = &["mocha", "macchiato", "frappe", "latte", "dracula", "alucard"]` to crates/mp-model/src/config.rs; mp config.rs and config_docs.rs re-export/use it (delete both local copies); regenerate tests/fixtures/golden/mp-config-schema.json.
Parity test in raul: the set of theme::ALL names equals mp_model UI_THEMES (MONOCHROME stays outside both).

ALUCARD palette in crates/raul/src/theme.rs, mirroring DRACULA's role mapping with the official Alucard Classic values (draculatheme.com/spec): accent Purple #644AC9, success Green #14710A, warn Yellow #846E15, danger Red #CB3A2A, dim Comment #6C664B, foreground #1F1F1F; added to ALL and Palette::by_name.

Theme picker (new crates/raul/src/tui/modes/settings/theme_picker.rs + render in render/overlays.rs::render_settings_list): the ui.theme row expands to 7 rows — 6 named palettes (name, 6-role swatch drawn in that palette, one-line description) + 'Default (mocha)' reset row; below them a one-row status preview (in-progress / done / ready / blocked / accent / dim) in the highlighted palette.
Live apply: moving the highlight (arrows, j/k, mouse hover/click) sets App::palette immediately; the next frame repaints.

Save / cancel: s (the existing Settings save key) writes the highlighted name via mp config set ui.theme; Esc restores the saved palette. The reset row previews mocha; saving it writes ui.theme=mocha.
Mouse: each picker row registers a hit rect via the existing mouse plumbing (tui/mouse.rs).
Update the ui.theme description in config_docs.rs to 'Theme palette name. raul's Settings picker previews live; s saves.' and docs/raul/settings.md.
out_of_scope: Custom user palettes (user direction: not planned).
New palette roles (focus_ring, surfaces) — see M244.
Listing MONOCHROME in the picker (it remains the no-color fallback).

acceptance_criteria.description: UI_THEMES is defined once (mp_model) with 6 names including alucard; mp config set ui.theme accepts alucard; raul's palette names match it exactly (parity test).
acceptance_criteria.verification: test "$(rg -l 'pub const UI_THEMES' crates | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1 && cargo nextest run -p mp --test suite_config --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/ui_theme/)' && cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/theme_catalog_parity/)'

acceptance_criteria.description: ALUCARD is in theme::ALL with the official Alucard Classic values mapped like DRACULA; Palette::by_name("alucard") resolves without fallback.
FRAPPE.dim is 0xa5adce (Subtext0), consistent with the other Catppuccin palettes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -q 'dim: rgb\(0xa5adce\)' crates/raul/src/theme.rs && cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/frappe_dim_matches_spec/)'

acceptance_criteria.description: The ui.theme row expands to 7 picker rows (6 named palettes with swatch + description, then 'Default (mocha)'); MONOCHROME is not listed; keyboard and mouse move the highlight.
A one-row status preview under the picker renders in-progress / done / ready / blocked / accent / dim using the highlighted palette.
Moving the highlight sets App::palette immediately and the next frame paints with it.
s saves the highlighted theme via mp config set ui.theme; Esc restores the saved palette; the ui.theme description no longer says relaunch.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast --test tui_theme_picker -E 'test(/save|esc_reverts/)' && ! rg -q 'relaunch to apply' crates/mp/src/config_docs.rs

acceptance_criteria.description: The reset row previews mocha; saving it writes ui.theme=mocha.
The Settings header chip shows 'saved: <name>' or 'preview: <name> (saved: <name>)'.
mp and raul tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean; the config-schema golden is regenerated additively.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp -p raul --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p mp -p raul --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && make consumer-surface-lint
